preOutputReview: Scoring written before opening any new responses. Root batch API calls already started; references and primary IoU matching protocol were frozen before calls. No output used in reference/scoring decisions.
colorNormalization: Case/whitespace/Korean basic-color aliases; cyan/turquoise accepted as blue for photographed blue dice. No mixed-color guesses accepted.
structured: Object key order ignored; marks order ignored; explicit zero costs equivalent to absent zero-cost symbol.
unknown: An observed claim where reference is ambiguous is unverified, not automatically a hallucination.
referenceLimit: AI visual annotations, no independent human certification.

amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.change: Include failed API-200 semantic-decode attempts as zero usable observations / all reference facts missing; never omit failures from aggregate denominators.
amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.reason: Operational failure rate is essential; no paid retry.

amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.change: Accept literal color plus plastic/wooden material suffix as same color, retaining initial root scores separately.
amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.reason: green plastic and green describe the same visible color; not a color error.

amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.change: Report duplicate color aliases as one unique visible fact, alongside strict per-property metrics.
amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.reason: dieColor/observedColor and trainColor/observedColor describe the same fact; omission of a redundant alias must not be mistaken for loss of a distinct fact.

amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.change: For projected Splendor cards, development/deck readout kind supplies front/back semantic face.
amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.reason: Native product record encodes face through kind; no actual face information was lost.

amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.change: After worker outputs, expanded literal shape descriptors (four/five squares, T/L/Y/cross/straight), colored-wall synonyms, and Azul pattern color aliases. Exact bitmap identity under rotation/reflection remains required; non-equivalent cell counts remain wrong.
amendmentsAfterOpeningRootOutputs.reason: Avoid counting equivalent free-text descriptions as recognition errors. These post-output scoring changes are disclosed, not a preregistered independent measure.

workerBeforeCalls.partialInventories: Blokus and Kingdomino explicitly have uncertain touching groups. Score clearly distinct single objects only; group regions ignore unmatched centers. Global full-inventory metrics separately restrict to eight exhaustive photographs.
workerBeforeCalls.aliases: Azul printed patterns mapped to corresponding tile categories, terrain and marker descriptions lexical equivalents, polyomino bitmaps rotation/reflection canonicalized when supplied, duplicate printedName/word coalesced only when identical expected fact. Free text otherwise exact after case/whitespace normalization.
workerBeforeCalls.note: All these worker rules frozen before worker paid calls. Root original reference/scoring remains separately retained.

auditPolicy: Post-call overrides separate; original references byte-identical. Uncertain component kind excluded from kind denominator only. See audit-overrides.json and reference-audit.json.
